Fumiko Takekuma (Japanese: 武隈史子 Takekuma Fumiko) is a Japanese voice actress for and .

==Biography==
Takekuma was born on February 23, 1980 in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. Her best known roles in the were , one of ; James's Mareanie; and Kiawe's Marowak; all of these roles were in .
